data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Branch SDK supporting deep links, attribution, and analytics.
data.what_it_does: Implements the Branch SDK for cross-platform deep linking, referral systems, user attribution, and analytics across Android, iOS, and Web. It provides functionalities to generate deep links, share sheets, track user actions, and handle sessions.
use_when: You need deep linking with attribution and referral capabilities.
Your app relies on Branch.io for marketing, sharing, and invites.
avoid_when: You only need basic local routing or simple custom URL schemes without external attribution services.
You prefer an alternative deep linking solution that doesn't depend on a third-party backend like Branch.
strengths: Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, and Web.
Automated handling of native Branch SDK dependencies.
Supports modern iOS UISceneDelegate lifecycle and deferred deep linking.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration on the Branch Dashboard and native configuration files (AndroidManifest.xml, Info.plist, or branch-config.json).
Web integration requires adding custom JavaScript to index.html.
data.setup_notes: Requires disabling default Flutter deep linking, configuring Android Manifest and iOS Info.plist or branch-config.json, adding JavaScript snippets for Web, and setting up the Branch Dashboard.
